title: ScenarioForge: Resource-Grounded Generation and Execution Validation of Cyber Exercises
abstract: arXiv:2611.21579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cyber-range and capture-the-flag scenario construction remains labor-intensive because authors must coordinate infrastructure, vulnerable services, attack paths, artifacts, and success conditions. LLMs can propose detailed exercises, but plausible descriptions do not guarantee deployable software or verifiable objectives. We present ScenarioForge, which turns high-level requirements into resource-grounded topologies, services, traffic, segmentation, and challenge chains, then instantiates and validates them in the Common Open Research Emulator (CORE). The ScenarioForge Execution Dataset contains 226 materialized scenarios covering 294 Vulhub images and all 85 custom-built challenge-resource generators developed with our AI-assisted scaffolding. All 226 passed construction, preview, sequencing, deployment, strict runtime validation, and live artifact checks; their 867 steps, each an individually verifiable challenge objective, comprise

translated_title: ScenarioForge：基于资源的网络演习场景生成与执行验证
translated_abstract: 网络靶场与夺旗（CTF）场景的构建仍然是一项劳动密集型工作，因为作者需要协调基础设施、易受攻击的服务、攻击路径、制品以及成功条件。大语言模型（LLM）虽然能够提出详细的演习方案，但看似合理的描述并不能保证生成可部署的软件或可验证的目标。我们提出了ScenarioForge，它能够将高层需求转化为基于实际资源的拓扑结构、服务、流量、网络分割和挑战链，然后在通用开放研究仿真器（CORE）中进行实例化和验证。ScenarioForge执行数据集包含226个已实例化的场景，涵盖294个Vulhub镜像以及我们借助AI辅助脚手架开发的全部85个自定义挑战资源生成器。所有226个场景均通过了构建、预览、排序、部署、严格运行时验证和实时制品检查；其867个步骤——每一步都是一个可单独验证的挑战目标——构成了……
tldr: ScenarioForge能够将高层需求自动转化为资源可落地的网络演习场景，并在CORE仿真器中实例化与严格验证，其数据集包含226个全部通过部署与运行时验证的场景及867个可单独验证的挑战目标。
en_tdlr: ScenarioForge automatically transforms high-level requirements into resource-grounded cyber exercise scenarios that are instantiated and rigorously validated in the CORE emulator, contributing a dataset of 226 fully validated scenarios comprising 867 individually verifiable challenge objectives.
